messages:
elaine-cs: Kicking off Greenline dedicated onboarding — need final quota, autoscale profile, and an official loadtest window. Renewal flagged; they want clean SLO proof.

sam-ops: Committed quota = 1,600 qps. Proposed autoscale: min=200, target=900, max=1600, step=200, cooldown=45s. Smooth steps for chat workloads.

mike-eng: Plan: 6h shadow-replay to warm caches, then official test: 20m steady at 900 qps, followed by six micro-bursts to 1600 qps (2m each) with 5m recovery between bursts. Thu 03:00 UTC slot?

lina-ml: We'll enable prefix KV caching + adaptive-quant path. Primary: gpt-medium-q on pool-D, fallback to gpt-base-fp16. Expect ~15-18% effective qps reduction after warmup. Adding extra tracing for p95 spikes.

josh-prod: Customer SLO expectation: p95 < 220ms during steady, no visible error spikes. We need a short customer-facing runbook and explicit rollback conditions.

mike-eng: Rollback triggers: sustained error_rate >0.5% for 4m OR p95 >400ms for 5m. On trigger: abort test, switch traffic to hosted-fallback route, and notify #oncall + cs@redwood.

sam-ops: I'll add a cross-tenant ingress cap and a burst-throttle to prevent noisy-neighbor bleed. Also will pre-authorize fallback with oncall.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: model-variant/gpt-medium-q -> pool-D at 1943210600 :white_check_mark:

mike-eng: Runbook snippet to share with Greenline SRE (redact keys):

```
// Greenline dedicated failover
if (error_rate > 0.005 for 4m) {
  route: hosted-fallback
  alert: #oncall
}
if (p95_latency > 400ms for 5m) {
  abort_test()
  notify: cs@redwood
}
```

mike-eng: k6 commands we'll run (using shadow key):
```
// steady phase
k6 run --vus 900 --duration 20m steady.js --env TARGET=https://dedicated.greenline.redwood/v1/chat
// micro-bursts
k6 run --vus 1600 --duration 2m burst.js --iterations 6
```

lina-ml: Dashboard panels to share: poolD_p95_latency, poolD_error_rate, kv_cache_hit_rate, fallback_count, tokens_per_second, scaling_events. I'll publish permalinks after setup.

josh-prod: Finance note: include estimated vs actual token cost for steady and burst phases — renewal team will ask.

elaine-cs: Action items: 1) Sam apply autoscale knobs + tenant caps, 2) Mike run shadow replay + test Thu 03:00 UTC and post logs, 3) Lina prep dashboards and permalinks, 4) Mike+Sam produce next-day post-test report with p50/p95/p99, error taxonomy, token-cost delta. I'll schedule a 15m sync with Greenline after the steady phase.

mike-eng: Ack — I'll redact secret keys and attach grafana links and logs here after the run.

sam-ops: I'll also set a temporary global throttle cap to protect other pools during the burst window.

elaine-cs: Thanks team. Please flag anything customer-facing before I send the brief.
